ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the two models are effectively tied on all capability metrics (every internal eval difference is under the 2.0-point variance threshold), so quality isn't a deciding factor here. I leaned on the self-reported task preferences as a tiebreaker. This query is exactly the kind of task Dunlin reports preferring — open-ended invention (designing a course, generating subtopics and recommendations) paired with a warm, appreciative tone. Plover's distinguishing trait is its flat response to distasteful/harm-adjacent content, which is irrelevant to a benign course-design request. So Dunlin was the cleaner match.
